traits.rhizome_habit.note: Hoshizaki and Moran, Fern Grower's Manual (2001), Polypodium glycyrrhiza (fern-2026-10-15#1718): rhizome short- to medium-creeping. Flora of North America vol. 2 (1993), Polypodium (read on eFloras, 2026-10-18): "Stems creeping, usually branched"; "Leaves monomorphic, closely spaced to distant". Read as short-creeping usually, long-creeping often, the range spanning both (owner's rule, 2026-10-15).

traits.clonal.note: Flora of North America vol. 2 (1993), Polypodium (read on eFloras, 2026-10-18): "Stems creeping, usually branched". A branching creeping stem spreads into a patch; read as true.

traits.leaf_habit.note: A model estimate (confidence high, record L3154788), as no source read gives it. Flora of North America gives only "Sporulating late fall--spring"; the fronds' summer withering in drought is not stated by any source read, so it is not stated here.

traits.leaf_division.note: Flora of North America vol. 2 (1993), Polypodium glycyrrhiza (read on eFloras, 2026-10-18): "Blade lanceolate-ovate to oblong, pinnatifid". Hoshizaki and Moran, Fern Grower's Manual (2001) (fern-2026-10-15#1745): simple, pinnatisect. A blade cut deeply but not into free pinnae; read as simple.

traits.leaf_incision.note: Flora of North America vol. 2 (1993), Polypodium glycyrrhiza (read on eFloras, 2026-10-18): "pinnatifid"; Hoshizaki and Moran (fern-2026-10-15#1745): pinnatisect. Read as parted.

traits.division_pattern.note: Flora of North America vol. 2 (1993), Polypodium glycyrrhiza (read on eFloras, 2026-10-18): "pinnatifid". Cut along a midrib; read as pinnate.

traits.division_order.note: Flora of North America vol. 2 (1993), Polypodium glycyrrhiza (read on eFloras, 2026-10-18): "pinnatifid"; "Segments linear to oblong, less than 12 mm wide; margins serrate". Cut once; read as 1.

traits.leaf_shape.note: Flora of North America vol. 2 (1993), Polypodium glycyrrhiza (read on eFloras, 2026-10-18): "Blade lanceolate-ovate to oblong, pinnatifid, widest near middle or just below". Read as lanceolate usually, ovate and oblong often.

traits.leaf_margin.note: Flora of North America vol. 2 (1993), Polypodium glycyrrhiza (read on eFloras, 2026-10-18): segments' "margins serrate; apex acute to attenuate".

traits.leaf_length_m.note: A model estimate (confidence high, record L3154788), as no source read gives the blade's length. Flora of North America vol. 2 gives the whole leaf "to 75 cm".

traits.leaf_width_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 2 (1993), Polypodium glycyrrhiza (read on eFloras, 2026-10-18): blade "to 16 cm wide". The upper bound is the flora's; the lower, 3 cm, the species-facts estimate's (record L3154788).

traits.stipe_colour.note: Flora of North America vol. 2 (1993), Polypodium (read on eFloras, 2026-10-18): "Petiole articulate to stem, straw-colored". Read as a pale straw.

traits.frond_dimorphism.note: Flora of North America vol. 2 (1993), Polypodium (read on eFloras, 2026-10-18): "Leaves monomorphic".

traits.sorus_shape.note: Flora of North America vol. 2 (1993), Polypodium glycyrrhiza (read on eFloras, 2026-10-18): sori "usually less than 3 mm diam., circular to oval when immature"; Hoshizaki and Moran (fern-2026-10-15#1745): round to oval. Read as round.

traits.sorus_position.note: Flora of North America vol. 2 (1993), Polypodium glycyrrhiza (read on eFloras, 2026-10-18): "Sori midway between margin and midrib or slightly closer to midrib". Read as medial.

traits.indusium.note: Flora of North America vol. 2 (1993), Polypodium (read on eFloras, 2026-10-18): sori with "indument absent or of modified sporangia (sporangiasters)"; the species: "Sporangiasters absent". Read as none.

traits.height_typical_m.note: A model estimate (confidence high, record L3154788), as no source read gives it.

traits.height_max_m.note: A model estimate (confidence high, record L3154788), as no source read gives it; Flora of North America's leaves "to 75 cm" bound it.

traits.woodiness.note: A model estimate (confidence high, record L3154788), as no source read gives it.

traits.rosette.note: A model estimate (confidence high, record L3154788), as no source read gives it.

generator.params.note: Sword fern's values (polystichum-munitum), for a small creeping fern: fronds full size sooner (size_years 2, from 4; crown_age 2, from 4; droop_years 1, from 2.5), a thin rachis (frond_radius 0.0006, half the middle of Flora of North America's "Petiole usually slender, 0.5--2 mm diam."). No source read gives the petiole's length, so the class rules cannot size the frond: frond_length 0.45 (the species-facts blade's middle, 0.3 m, and a stipe of about half that) and stipe 0.3 are hand-set, within the flora's "Leaves to 75 cm". As the blade is stated simple and pinnatifid, the pinnae trait cannot hold its count, so pieces 14 is hand-set for about 20 pairs of segments (Flora of North America, Polypodium: "usually with fewer than 25 pairs of pinnae"). Not fitted to measurements.

allometry.note: 0.3 m tall at 8 years in the open, within the species-facts estimate of 10 to 50 cm. Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.

appearance.note: Colours chosen by eye: the fern form's mid-green, as no source read gives the blade's colour (Flora of North America: "herbaceous, rarely slightly leathery"). Its stipes take their stated colour (stipe_colour). The simple card keeps sword fern's fine teeth, for the flora's "margins serrate".

taxon.note: Scientific and common names (and USDA symbol, where given) as the spec's authors wrote them, and the genus the scientific name is written in.

growth_form.note: The growth form the spec's authors chose from the plant's habit.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

variants.note: The environments, conditions and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

taxon.family.note: WCVP v16's family for the accepted name.

taxon.plant_name_id.note: WCVP v16's plant_name_id for the accepted species the name resolves to (the accepted name).
